profile.headline: Principal iOS Software Engineer @ Turo
profile.summary: Results-driven iOS engineer with 12+ years building large-scale consumer mobile apps and the developer tooling behind them. Bridges product and platform work, architecting resilient and scalable code, modernizing CI/CD, and building AI infrastructure. Business-focused engineer who ties technical decisions to measurable outcomes while keeping a high bar for technical excellence.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Turo is the world’s largest peer-to-peer car rental marketplace. We connect people who need a car with vehicle owners whose car would otherwise be idle. Turo is driving the “sharing or peer to peer economy,” where idle assets are put to better use.

As Staff Software Engineer I am responsible for leading the continued development of the company’s business operations in regard to supporting Turo’s iOS application.

positions.title: Co-founder. Full stack developer.
positions.description:
GestionaTuLiga is a startup that provides an innovative system to manage sport competitions, used by more than 15.000 users all over the world. 
Responsible of iOS development, backend and frontend. Using Cocoa, Objective-C, Swift, Django, REST, AngularJS, HTML5, JavaScript and CSS3.
BaaS management with AWS y Azure.
Sales, marketing and business.
